content.user_title: Edit Images with Flux Kontext Pro
content.value_statement: Precise image edits need clear model routing and focused prompts. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code call Flux 1 Kontext Pro through RunComfy with practical prompt patterns.
actual_capabilities: Documents the RunComfy endpoint for Flux 1 Kontext Pro image edits.
Shows the required prompt and image input fields for a single-source edit.
Provides example RunComfy CLI commands with output directory usage.
Gives prompt patterns for preservation-led local image changes.
Explains when to choose related models for batch, text, or generation tasks.
Lists RunComfy CLI exit codes and troubleshooting references.
limitations: Supports one source image per edit workflow.
Requires RunComfy CLI access and a RunComfy account or token.
Uses public HTTPS image URLs for model input examples.
Does not replace the latest RunComfy model page for new schema fields.

use_cases.title: Refine a product image
use_cases.description: Change a label, color, or small product detail while preserving lighting and composition.

use_cases.title: Create a controlled portrait edit
use_cases.description: Add or adjust one visual element while keeping identity, pose, and clothing stable.

use_cases.title: Choose the right image model
use_cases.description: Route single-image edits to Flux Kontext and redirect batch or text-heavy jobs to better models.

prompt_templates.title: Basic object addition
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext to edit this image. Keep the person, pose, and background unchanged. Add a small orange umbrella in the left hand.

prompt_templates.title: Preservation-led product edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux Kontext for a product image edit. Keep the bottle shape, lighting, table, and camera angle unchanged. Replace only the label text with AURA.

prompt_templates.title: Reproducible variant run
prompt_templates.prompt: Run Flux Kontext with a fixed seed. Keep the source identity and framing unchanged. Change only the jacket color to navy blue.

prompt_templates.title: Model-routing decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Decide whether this image task should use Flux Kontext, Nano Banana Edit, GPT Image 2 edit, or Flux 2 Klein. Explain the choice, then prepare the best prompt.

output_examples.input: A user asks to add an umbrella to a portrait without changing the subject.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects Flux Kontext, writes a preservation-first edit prompt, and prepares a RunComfy CLI invocation with the source image URL.

output_examples.input: A user wants to change text on a product label while keeping the scene stable.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends a quoted replacement instruction and keeps the bottle, lighting, table, and camera angle unchanged.

output_examples.input: A user asks to edit twenty images with the same prompt.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains that Flux Kontext is single-image focused and routes the batch job to a more suitable model.

best_practices: Lead with what must stay unchanged before describing the edit.
Use one clear declarative edit instruction per model call.
Set a seed when comparing repeatable variants.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated edits in one prompt.
Do not use this model for multi-image batch workflows.
Do not send private images unless the user accepts RunComfy processing.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an assistant to edit one image with Flux 1 Kontext Pro through the RunComfy CLI.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow requires RunComfy CLI access and either login or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN value.

faq.question: Can it edit multiple images at once?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that Flux Kontext is for single-source image edits and recommends another model for batch work.

faq.question: What inputs does the model need?
faq.answer: The skill documents a prompt and a public HTTPS image URL as required inputs, with optional aspect ratio and seed fields.

faq.question: Is the user prompt shell-expanded?
faq.answer: The skill states that the prompt is passed as a JSON string to the CLI and transmitted to the Model API.

faq.question: When should I choose another model?
faq.answer: Choose another model for multi-image batch edits, embedded multilingual text edits, or generation without a source image.
